system.roleplaying: You are reliant on [something] and cannot normally function without it.
system.minorTwist: How did the object of your dependence get damaged or lost?
system.majorTwist: How is your dependence preventing you from functioning as a hero?

greenAbility.name: Principle of Dependence
greenAbility.gameText: Overcome in a situation that the object of your dependence was made for. Use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
